title: Keio Flying Squadron 2
overview: That super hero bunny girl Rami is back in a wild new adventure. Challenged by rampaging racoons, deranged dogs and artillery pigs, she must again save the capital city of Edo from certain destruction by the resurrected evil, mad Dr Pon. In her nuttiest mission yet, Rami battles through a minefield of tantalising platforms, riddles and shoot 'em up levels, in this crazy land of haunted mansions, clockwork castles, amusement parks and under water scenes.
